Name: HDFC Bank
About: India's largest private sector bank by size, offering retail and corporate banking, loans, cards and payments. It merged with its parent HDFC Ltd in 2023, which added a large home-loan book.
Watch: Deposit growth after the merger, net interest margin, and the level of bad loans.

Name: ICICI Bank
About: A large private sector bank with strong retail lending, and insurance, asset management and broking businesses through group companies.
Watch: Net interest margin, growth in retail loans, and bad-loan levels.

Name: SBI
About: India's largest public sector bank, with the biggest branch network in the country. It serves everyone from rural customers to large companies and the government.
Watch: Asset quality, government ownership, and how profitably it lends compared with private banks.

Name: Kotak Mahindra Bank
About: A private bank that grew out of a Mumbai finance company into a financial services group with banking, wealth management and asset management.
Watch: Net interest margin and the quality of its loan book.

Name: Axis Bank
About: A large private sector bank offering retail, corporate and digital banking. It took over Citibank's Indian consumer business in 2023.
Watch: How well the acquired business is integrated, net interest margin and bad-loan trends.

Name: TCS
About: India's largest IT services company and part of the Tata Group. It provides software, consulting and outsourcing to global clients in banking, retail, manufacturing and other industries.
Watch: Demand from big global clients, operating margin, and how AI changes IT services.

Name: Infosys
About: A Bengaluru-based global IT services and consulting company known for digital transformation and outsourcing work for large international clients.
Watch: Revenue growth in constant currency, operating margin and large-deal wins.

Name: Wipro
About: A Bengaluru-based global IT services and consulting company working across technology services and business process outsourcing.
Watch: Whether its growth and margins catch up with larger peers, and spending on acquisitions.

Name: HCL Tech
About: A Noida-based IT services company that also earns from engineering services and its own software products.
Watch: The mix between services and software products, margins and growth in engineering services.

Name: Tech Mahindra
About: A Mahindra Group IT company with a large base of telecom clients, offering IT services, network services and business process services.
Watch: Dependence on telecom clients, margin recovery and new deal wins.

Name: Hindustan Unilever
About: India's biggest consumer goods company, part of Unilever. It sells soaps, detergents, personal care, foods and beverages under many household brands.
Watch: Rural demand, raw-material costs, and volume growth versus price increases.

Name: ITC
About: A diversified company that earns most of its profit from cigarettes, with growing businesses in packaged foods, hotels, paper and agriculture.
Watch: Tax changes on cigarettes and how fast its non-cigarette FMCG businesses grow.

Name: Nestle India
About: The Indian arm of Nestlé, known for Maggi noodles, Nescafé coffee, KitKat and infant nutrition.
Watch: Raw-material costs such as milk and wheat, pricing, and royalty payments to the parent.

Name: Britannia
About: One of India's leading biscuit and bakery companies, with brands such as Good Day and Marie Gold.
Watch: Wheat, sugar and palm oil prices, and growth in new product categories.

Name: Dabur
About: A long-established Indian company in ayurvedic and natural products, known for Chyawanprash, Real juices and personal care.
Watch: Rural demand, seasonal products and growth in healthcare and personal care.

Name: Sun Pharma
About: One of India's largest drug makers, selling generic medicines in India and abroad as well as specialty drugs.
Watch: US specialty drug sales, regulatory approvals and factory inspection results.

Name: Dr Reddy's
About: A Hyderabad-based drug maker selling generic medicines mainly in the US, India and Europe.
Watch: US generic pricing, new product launches and regulator inspections.

Name: Cipla
About: A Mumbai-based pharma company known for respiratory medicines and affordable HIV drugs, with business in India, the US and Africa.
Watch: Respiratory drug sales, growth in India and regulatory approvals.

Name: Divi's Labs
About: A maker of active ingredients and intermediates for global drug companies. It works mostly behind the scenes as a supplier.
Watch: Dependence on a few large customers, custom manufacturing orders and profit margins.

Name: Lupin
About: A Mumbai-based drug company with a large presence in the US and India, strong in respiratory and heart medicines.
Watch: US generic pricing and approvals, and the results of regulator inspections.

Name: Maruti Suzuki
About: India's biggest car maker by sales, majority-owned by Japan's Suzuki and known for small and mid-size cars.
Watch: Demand for entry-level cars, the shift to SUVs and input costs.

Name: Mahindra & Mahindra
About: A leading maker of SUVs and tractors in India, and the flagship of the Mahindra Group.
Watch: SUV demand, tractor sales tied to farm incomes and its electric vehicle rollout.

Name: Bajaj Auto
About: A major maker of motorcycles and three-wheelers with a large export business, known for the Pulsar.
Watch: Export demand, currency movements and its electric vehicle plans.

Name: Hero MotoCorp
About: India's largest two-wheeler maker by volume, known for commuter motorcycles and scooters.
Watch: Rural demand, entry-level bike sales and the shift to electric two-wheelers.

Name: Eicher Motors
About: Maker of Royal Enfield motorcycles and, through a joint venture with Volvo, commercial vehicles.
Watch: Royal Enfield volumes, export growth and raw-material costs.

Name: Reliance Industries
About: One of India's largest companies, spanning oil refining and petrochemicals, retail, and telecom and digital services through Jio.
Watch: Refining margins, growth in Jio and retail, and spending on new energy.

Name: ONGC
About: India's biggest oil and gas explorer and producer, majority-owned by the government.
Watch: Crude oil prices, government pricing decisions and production volumes.

Name: NTPC
About: India's largest power generator, mostly state-owned, running coal and gas plants and a growing set of renewable projects.
Watch: Power demand, coal supply and how quickly it adds renewable capacity.

Name: Power Grid
About: A state-owned company that operates most of India's long-distance electricity transmission network and earns regulated returns.
Watch: Regulated returns on projects, new transmission contracts and dividend payouts.

Name: Coal India
About: One of the world's largest coal producers, mostly state-owned, supplying most of India's coal.
Watch: Coal demand from power plants, production growth and pricing.

Name: Angel One
About: A major discount stockbroker in India with a large base of retail investors who trade through its mobile app.
Watch: Trading volumes, rule changes for derivatives and its number of active clients.

Name: BSE Ltd
About: One of Asia's oldest stock exchanges. It earns fees from trading, listings and data, and has a large derivatives business.
Watch: Derivatives trading volumes and regulatory changes to options trading.

Name: CDSL
About: Central Depository Services holds investors' shares in electronic form and earns fees on accounts and transactions.
Watch: New demat accounts, market activity and the number of IPOs.

Name: MCX
About: Multi Commodity Exchange of India runs trading in commodities such as gold, silver, crude oil and base metals.
Watch: Commodity price swings, trading volumes and regulation of products.

Name: Motilal Oswal
About: A financial services group offering broking, wealth management, asset management and housing finance.
Watch: Income that rises and falls with the market, fund inflows and fund performance.

Name: Dixon Technologies
About: A leading Indian electronics manufacturer that makes TVs, appliances and mobile phones under contract for other brands.
Watch: Dependence on a few big clients, government incentive schemes and thin margins.

Name: Kaynes Technology
About: An electronics manufacturer serving automotive, aerospace, industrial and medical clients, and moving into semiconductor packaging.
Watch: Order book growth, working capital needs and its semiconductor plans.

Name: Syrma SGS
About: An electronics manufacturer making products for industrial, automotive, healthcare and consumer clients, from circuit boards to finished devices.
Watch: Margins, customer concentration and working capital.

Name: Amber Enterprises
About: Makes parts and finished products for air conditioners and, through subsidiaries, electronics such as circuit boards.
Watch: Seasonal demand for air conditioners, customer concentration and borrowing levels.

Name: Avalon Technologies
About: An electronics manufacturer providing circuit boards, cables and complete product assembly, with a large share of customers in the US.
Watch: Orders from a few large customers, margins and export demand.
